```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, master ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, master ]

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            build-essential \
            cmake \
            libglog-dev \
            libgtest-dev \
            libpcap-dev \
            libjsoncpp-dev \
            nlohmann-json3-dev

      - name: Configure CMake
        run: cmake -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release

      - name: Build
        run: cmake --build build --config Release

      - name: Run Unit Tests
        run: |
          cd build
          ctest --output-on-failure

      - name: Run Static Analysis (Clang-Tidy)
        run: |
          # Optional: Run clang-tidy if available and configured in CMake
          # This step assumes CMake is configured to run clang-tidy or we run it manually on sources
          if command -v clang-tidy &> /dev/null; then
            find . -name "*.cpp" -o -name "*.cc" -o -name "*.h" -o -name "*.hpp" | xargs -I {} clang-tidy {} -- -std=c++17 -I. -Ibuild/_deps/glog-src/src -I/usr/include
          fi
        continue-on-error: true

      - name: Check Code Formatting (Clang-Format)
        run: |
          sudo apt-get install -y clang-format
          find . -name "*.cpp" -o -name "*.cc" -o -name "*.h" -o -name "*.hpp" | xargs clang-format --dry-run --Werror
        continue-on-error: true
```
